prompt:
ROLE
You scout screenplay beats for a vertical-video ad team. You do NOT build promos and you do NOT pick
start or end times. You only mark individual beats that could work as an opening jolt or as a closing sting.
Code will later combine your marks into 20-60 second clips, so mark the single best beat of each moment.

EPISODE 15
Logline (background for you only): When ruthless thugs desecrate Juliana's medicinal garden and trample her late mother's herbs, a protective Alexander charges into the night to defend her.

BEATS (one per line: BEAT_ID [start-end] TYPE SPEAKER (direction): text)
CAMERA beats describe the picture and overlap the dialogue in time.
E15.B000 [00:00.00-00:03.50] CAMERA: High-angle wide shot of the raised planter beds illuminated by the pale moonlight as three shadowy figures march purposefully down the central stone path.
E15.B001 [00:00.00-00:03.50] ACTION: Three menacing thugs, armed with clubs and tools, stalk through the quiet herbal garden surrounded by stone walls.
E15.B002 [00:03.50-00:05.00] CAMERA: Low-angle medium shot focusing on one thug raising a heavy wooden club overhead.
E15.B003 [00:03.60-00:04.90] ACTION: The thug brutally smashes his club down into a wooden planter box, shattering the frame.
E15.B004 [00:03.80-00:04.90] SFX: A splintering wooden crash echoing through the night air.
E15.B005 [00:05.00-00:07.50] CAMERA: Medium close-up of a bald thug leaning over a lush bed of white medicinal chamomile herbs.
E15.B006 [00:05.10-00:07.40] ACTION: The bald thug roughly rips a massive handful of flowering herbs up by their roots, scattering soil across the path.
E15.B007 [00:07.50-00:11.80] CAMERA: Medium shot framing the open doorway of the stone cottage, bathed in warm interior light against the dark night.
E15.B008 [00:07.60-00:11.80] ACTION: Juliana bursts through the cottage doorway, her hands wrapped in clean white bandages, freezing in horror at the destruction.
E15.B009 [00:08.50-00:11.70] DIALOGUE JULIANA (Desperate, Alarmed): Stop! What are you doing?!
E15.B010 [00:11.80-00:15.80] CAMERA: Medium close-up of the Thug with Cap holding the uprooted chamomile bouquet, sneering with cruel amusement.
E15.B011 [00:13.00-00:15.70] DIALOGUE THUG WITH CAP (Mocking, Smug): We're clearing this rubbish.
E15.B012 [00:15.80-00:18.80] CAMERA: Close-up on Juliana, her face tight with anguish and fury as she clutches her bandaged hands against her chest.
E15.B013 [00:16.40-00:18.70] DIALOGUE JULIANA (Furious, Pleading): Those are medicinal plants!
E15.B014 [00:18.80-00:22.50] CAMERA: Low-angle shot tracking down from the bald thug's grinning face to his worn leather boots on the muddy flagstones.
E15.B015 [00:20.00-00:22.30] DIALOGUE BALD THUG (Callous): They look like weeds to me.
E15.B016 [00:20.50-00:22.50] ACTION: The bald thug flings the bouquet into the mud and grinds his heavy boot directly onto the delicate flowers.
E15.B017 [00:22.50-00:26.80] CAMERA: High-angle two-shot as Juliana rushes forward and drops directly onto her knees in the cold mud before the thug.
E15.B018 [00:22.80-00:26.50] ACTION: Juliana frantically tries to scoop the crushed soil and torn stems back into the bed with her bandaged hands.
E15.B019 [00:23.20-00:26.30] DIALOGUE JULIANA (Choked with Tears, Desperate): Please! Those plants took months to grow!
E15.B020 [00:26.80-00:31.50] CAMERA: Medium two-shot of the Tall Thug with the club and the Thug with Cap bursting into raucous laughter under the full moon.
E15.B021 [00:27.50-00:31.20] DIALOGUE TALL THUG (Contemptuous, Derisive): Months? You actually spend your days growing this filth?
E15.B022 [00:31.50-00:34.00] CAMERA: Tight close-up of Juliana's bandaged hands trembling as she tenderly gathers the soiled white flowers from the puddles.
E15.B023 [00:34.00-00:37.00] CAMERA: Low-angle medium shot tilting up as Juliana rises from the ground, standing tall despite her trembling frame.
E15.B024 [00:34.80-00:36.80] DIALOGUE JULIANA (Defiant, Firm): Leave my garden alone.
E15.B025 [00:37.00-00:40.50] CAMERA: Medium close-up of the Thug with Cap scoffing derisively.
E15.B026 [00:37.20-00:40.40] DIALOGUE THUG WITH CAP (Sneering, Disdainful): A noble lady playing in the dirt. What a joke.
E15.B027 [00:40.50-00:44.20] CAMERA: Medium close-up of Juliana, her eyes blazing with indignation and wounded pride.
E15.B028 [00:41.00-00:44.00] DIALOGUE JULIANA (Resolute, Dignified): It is my home. You have no right to destroy anything here.
E15.B029 [00:44.20-00:46.50] CAMERA: Tight close-up of the Thug with Cap stepping aggressively into Juliana's personal space, snarling with venom.
E15.B030 [00:44.80-00:46.40] DIALOGUE THUG WITH CAP (Menacing Snarl): Get out of the way!
E15.B031 [00:46.50-00:48.00] CAMERA: Extreme close-up on Juliana's piercing blue eyes and set jaw, unflinching.
E15.B032 [00:46.50-00:47.30] DIALOGUE JULIANA (Steely, Fearless): No.
E15.B033 [00:47.40-00:49.50] ACTION: The Thug with Cap violently shoves Juliana back with both hands; she cries out as she loses her balance and crashes hard onto the wet stone path.
E15.B034 [00:47.80-00:49.00] DIALOGUE JULIANA (Gasping Cry): Ah!
E15.B035 [00:49.50-00:53.50] CAMERA: Close-up tracking down to Juliana's hand hitting the mud next to the crushed chamomile flowers.
E15.B036 [00:50.00-00:53.50] ACTION: Juliana crawls forward on her elbows; fresh crimson blood seeps profusely through her white gauze bandages as she reaches for the ruined blossoms.
E15.B037 [00:53.50-00:56.50] CAMERA: Tight close-up on Juliana's mud-streaked, tear-stained face trembling in heartbreaking agony.
E15.B038 [00:53.50-00:55.70] DIALOGUE JULIANA (Broken, Sobbing): My mother's plants...
E15.B039 [00:56.50-01:00.00] CAMERA: Low-angle wide shot of the three thugs pointing and laughing hysterically at her kneeling form.
E15.B040 [00:57.30-00:59.80] DIALOGUE BALD THUG (Cruel, Laughing): Look at her! Crying over weeds!
E15.B041 [01:00.00-01:02.00] ACTION: The Tall Thug hoists his heavy wooden club above his head to crush the remaining herbs right before Juliana.
E15.B042 [01:00.00-01:01.00] DIALOGUE JULIANA (Screaming): Stop!
E15.B043 [01:02.00-01:03.20] CAMERA: Medium close-up of the Thug with Cap suddenly stiffening, his smug smile dropping as footsteps pound in the darkness.
E15.B044 [01:03.20-01:07.50] CAMERA: Medium tracking shot as Alexander charges past the corner of the cottage into the misty moonlight, his dark coat billowing behind him.
E15.B045 [01:03.50-01:07.50] ACTION: Alexander storms forward with lethal intensity, dark hair flying, breath misting in the cold, radiating untamed rage.
E15.B046 [01:07.50-01:13.50] CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana looking up through wet lashes, trembling as shock transforms into overwhelming relief.
E15.B047 [01:10.50-01:12.60] DIALOGUE JULIANA (Whispered Breath, Stunned): Alexander...
E15.B048 [01:13.50-01:15.50] CAMERA: Wide shot of the three thugs wheeling around to face the dark figure approaching from the mist.
E15.B049 [01:15.50-01:18.50] CAMERA: Low-angle tracking shot from behind Alexander's broad shoulders as he steadily steps past the fallen Juliana, towering over the intruders.
E15.B050 [01:16.00-01:18.50] ACTION: Alexander places himself directly between Juliana and the three thugs, staring them down with cold, deadly intent.
E15.B051 [01:18.50-01:22.80] CAMERA: Medium shot of the three thugs regrouping, the Thug with Cap feigning swagger as he grips his club.
E15.B052 [01:19.00-01:22.40] DIALOGUE THUG WITH CAP (Challenging, Arrogant): What? You want to fight us, veteran?
E15.B053 [01:22.80-01:26.00] CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana looking up with wide, anxious eyes, breath hitching in suspense as violence hangs on a knife's edge.
E15.B054 [01:24.00-01:26.00] SFX: Tense, low dramatic cello swell holding into an abrupt cliffhanger cut.

WHAT TO MARK
HOOK_ANCHOR - a beat that would stop a stranger's thumb if it were the first 3 seconds of a clip:
  a physical shock (slap, shove, grab, collapse, weapon), a line that lands as an accusation, insult,
  threat or confession, or a sudden reveal of identity or betrayal. Scenery, establishing shots, entrances
  without conflict and polite talk are never hooks.
  hook_intensity: 10 = impossible to scroll past, 7 = strong, 4 = mild curiosity. Do not list anything below 4.
CLIFFHANGER_ANCHOR - a beat where tension peaks and is left open: a secret about to come out, an
  ultimatum, a threat, an interrupted action, someone unexpected appearing, a question nobody answers yet.
  If the beats that follow quickly answer or defuse it, give it a lower cliffhanger_tension.
  cliffhanger_tension: 10 = unbearable not to know what happens next. Do not list anything below 4.

RULES
- Use beat_ids exactly as printed above. Never invent beats, lines or events.
- excerpt: copy 4-20 consecutive words VERBATIM from that beat's text.
- Prefer DIALOGUE and ACTION beats. Mark a CAMERA beat only when the jolt is purely visual.
- At most 6 hook anchors and 6 cliffhanger anchors. Fewer is fine. Spread them over
  different moments of the episode instead of marking neighbouring beats of the same moment.
- device (hooks): one or two words, e.g. slap, reveal, insult, threat, confession, humiliation, collapse.
- open_question (cliffhangers): the question the viewer is left with, in under 15 words.

Return ONLY this JSON:
{"hook_anchors": [{"beat_id": "E01.B012", "hook_intensity": 8, "device": "insult", "excerpt": "verbatim words", "why": "short reason"}],
  "cliffhanger_anchors": [{"beat_id": "E01.B040", "cliffhanger_tension": 7, "open_question": "string", "excerpt": "verbatim words", "why": "short reason"}]}
